priorities.heading: Protecting Kansas Families from Rising Energy Bills
priorities.quote: We need a comprehensive, all of the above strategy that creates jobs and increases energy independence while bringing down costs for consumers today.

priorities.heading: Protecting the Security Kansas Seniors Have Earned
priorities.quote: Prioritize home-based care reimbursement to give seniors the option of aging at home instead of in a nursing facility or hospital.

priorities.heading: Housing Kansans Can Afford
priorities.quote: Modernize and standardize regulations for modular homes in order to increase the housing supply and provide more affordable options for families.

immigration.heading: Support Kansas Agriculture, Producers, and Consumers

priorities.heading: Agriculture
priorities.quote: On April 28, 2026, Doc introduced S. 4418 — the Lowering Input Costs for American Farmers Act — to eliminate the Biden-era countervailing duties on phosphate fertilizer imports from Morocco.

priorities.heading: Rural Healthcare
priorities.quote: In April 2026, Doc introduced the Medicare Advantage Improvement Act, which goes further: no more retroactive denials, no more automated denial algorithms, hard 72-hour caps.

priorities.heading: Border & Security
priorities.quote: The Laken Riley Act (S. 5) — which Doc cosponsored and President Trump signed into law on January 29, 2025 — was the first major bill of the 119th Congress: it requires ICE detention of unauthorized immigrants who commit certain crimes, including burglary, theft, assault on a law enforcement officer, or any offense causing death or serious injury.

cost-of-living.heading: Cost of Living
cost-of-living.quote: Doc voted yea on the Working Families Tax Cuts in 2025 to make the 2017 tax cuts permanent — the small business deduction, full expensing, R&D expensing, the expanded child tax credit.

foreign-policy.heading: Aerospace & Defense
foreign-policy.quote: On the defense side: NDAA FY2026 (S. 1071) carried Kansas-specific language Doc fought to include — funding for a new air-traffic-control tower at Fort Riley and an expanded training course at the post.
foreign-policy.note: This passage is about defense spending. The site doesn't discuss wars or conflicts abroad.

climate-energy.heading: Energy
climate-energy.quote: My top three priorities right now are E15, E15, and E15. All-of-the-above is the Kansas energy answer because it is the Kansas economic answer.
